rationale: M49 W1 (#768): the #744 bare-read walk treated every identifier that was not a declaration NAME as a read, so all remaining binding positions fabricated `uses @0.6` edges — import bindings (Default/named/alias/ns), parameters (alpha/beta), arrow-pattern targets (first/renamed/third), catch params (err), array-pattern targets (one/two) and export aliases (reexported, which is not a symbol at all). The JS F5 oracle carried the identical gate list, so the lane's uses audit agreed with the fabrication and stayed 100/0/0 (collusion, not verification); svelte/template-attr-shapes was the only fixture that saw it and its failure was misattributed to another agent's in-flight work. Contract: binding positions emit NO read edge; the RIGHT side of a pattern default is still a read; member-chain roots and bare expression reads keep emitting.
